summary: INNOVATE Corp. filed an 8-K regarding a merger agreement whereby subsidiary HC2 Broadcasting Holdings Inc. will merge with a CONX Corp. subsidiary. Broadcasting shareholders will receive 25% of the surviving entity's common stock, while CONX's Merger Sub interests convert into 75%, reflecting extinguishment of loans and a $75 million equity commitment. Closing requires regulatory approvals. This appears to be a de facto spin-off/divestiture of the broadcasting subsidiary as it emerges under CONX's control. Monitor clearance timeline and any stock consideration adjustments.
